content.value: Briefly explain magnetization vectors. Show that volume current density and surface current density are expressed as $\hat { J } _ { m } = \vec { \nabla } \times \vec { M } \cdot$ (A/m²)and $\therefore \vec { J } _ { m s } = \vec { M } \times \hat { a } _ { n }$ (A/m) respectively, where the symbols have their usual meanings in electromagnetics.
